neighbours.label: A word that marks picking one alternative over another: ' instead' (of), ' either' (… or), 'switched' (to), where the chosen or rejected option comes next
fire: She ordered the soup instead of the salad she usually has.
The band began with folk songs but later switched to electric blues.
Guests can stay either in the main house or in the cabin by the pond.
This year we are painting the fence instead of replacing it.
Halfway through college he switched to physics from chemistry.
The form can be sent either by post or through the website.
They walked along the canal instead of taking the crowded tram.
The farm sold its dairy herd and switched to growing vegetables.
quiet: She ordered the soup and the salad she usually has.
The band began with folk songs and ended with an old hymn.
Guests can stay in the main house, which has a view of the pond.
This year we are painting the fence and planting a hedge behind it.
Halfway through college he married a classmate from chemistry.
The form can be sent by post once it has been signed.
They walked along the canal and watched the barges go by.
The farm sold its dairy herd and the family moved to town.

notes: Card: ' instead' x7, ' either' x3, ' based' x3, ' exactly', ' simply', 'settled on', 'switched to'; reversed output promotes ' primarily', ' mainly', ' relying', ' both'. Probes: instead of 0.27, switched to 0.24, either…or 0.23; 'settled on' 0.02, 'based on' 0.04, 'exactly' 0.03, no-choice sentences 0.04-0.06. Weak activations: the median may miss 0.20.
